\section*{True / False (26 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False and justify briefly.}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Applications developed by \duallayerbox{programming languages}{scripting languages} like \_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_\_ have this common \duallayerbox{buffer-overflow error}{syntax error}.' is '\duallayerbox{C, C++}{Java}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'When a \duallayerbox{wireless}{secure} user authenticates to any AP, both of them go in the course of \duallayerbox{four-step}{three-step} \duallayerbox{authentication progression}{connection setup} which is called...' is 'wireless handshaking'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'In \duallayerbox{MD-5}{SHA-1} the length of the \duallayerbox{message digest}{hash output} is' is '\duallayerbox{128}{160}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What are the \duallayerbox{port states}{network states} determined by \duallayerbox{Nmap}{Wireshark}?' is '\duallayerbox{Open, filtered, unfiltered}{Closed, filtered}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Can a \duallayerbox{stream cipher}{block cipher} have \duallayerbox{perfect secrecy}{encryption}?' is 'No, since the \duallayerbox{key is shorter}{key is longer} than the message'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the \duallayerbox{following is not an example}{following is an example} of \duallayerbox{presentation layer issues}{network layer issues}?' is '\duallayerbox{Weak or non-existent authentication mechanisms}{Data encryption}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What tool can be used to \duallayerbox{perform}{simulate} \duallayerbox{SNMP enumeration}{network scanning}?' is '\duallayerbox{IP Network Browser}{Wireshark}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'A \duallayerbox{session symmetric key}{encryption key} \duallayerbox{between two parties}{in a network} is used' is '\duallayerbox{Only once}{Multiple times}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Man in the middle attack}{Phishing attack} can endanger the \duallayerbox{security}{integrity} of \duallayerbox{Diffie Hellman method}{RSA encryption} if two parties are not' is 'Joined'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'How is \duallayerbox{IP address spoofing}{MAC address spoofing} \duallayerbox{detected}{prevented}?' is '\duallayerbox{Comparing the TTL values}{Checking the MAC addresses} of the actual and spoofed addresses'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the \duallayerbox{following is not}{following is} a \duallayerbox{block cipher operating mode}{encryption algorithm}?' is '\duallayerbox{CBF}{CBC}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'The message must be encrypted at the \duallayerbox{sender site}{receiver site} and \duallayerbox{decrypted}{encrypted} at the' is '\duallayerbox{Sender Site}{Receiver Site}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What does EXE do when the \duallayerbox{STP solver}{SAT solver} times out on a constraint query for a particular path?' is 'Assume that the query is \duallayerbox{not satisfiable}{satisfiable} and \duallayerbox{stop executing the path}{continue executing}'.
\end{enumerate}
